How it works

From install to leaderboard in about a minute.

A read-only CLI collects your token counts. Your prompts and code never leave your machine. Only the numbers you choose to share.

01

Install the CLI

One command reads your usage from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 15 more tools, locally, on your machine.

$ npm install -g tokenmaxxer

02

Sync what you want

Private by default. Publish a public profile to compete, or keep your numbers to yourself. You're always in control.

03

Climb the board

Watch your rank move as you ship. Build streaks, chase the whales, and flex your all-time totals.

Read-only · open-source parsers · your transcripts stay local

Questions, answered

The important details.

Everything you need to know before connecting your first tool.

What leaves my machine?

Usage metadata only: token counts, which model and tool produced them, and the estimated cost. The TokenMaxxer CLI reads your local usage files read-only; your prompts, the model's responses, your code, and your file contents never leave your machine.

Can I keep my usage private?

Yes. Everything is private by default. A public profile and a place on the global leaderboard are both opt-in, so nothing is shared until you turn it on, and you can turn it back off at any time.

Which AI coding tools are supported?

The popular ones, from a single dashboard: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, OpenCode and more. If a tool records usage, TokenMaxxer can read it.

Is TokenMaxxer free?

Yes. Create an account, connect your tools, and start tracking everything for free.

Know exactly what you're burning

You're already spending the tokens. Make them count.

Get a detailed view of every model, tool, and dollar, then see how your usage stacks up.

安装命令行界面

一个命令可以从本地计算机上的 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和另外 15 个工具读取您的使用情况。

$ npm install -g tokenmaxxer

02

Can I keep my usage private?
